The gallery

Pictures taken inside Universe at Scale with its camera button — every planet, star and galaxy in them is where the measurements put it. Tap one to see it large.

Share yours

  1. Fly somewhere you love in the map, and press the camera button (top right) — it takes the picture without the menus or names.
  2. Save the picture.
  3. Send it here, with a title and the name you'd like shown.
Send a picture

Every picture is looked at before it goes up. Sending one needs a Google account (that's how the upload works).
